protocol.selection: highest eligible validation mean clean/dropout spell F1 above reference; misses, false positives and merge overlaps no worse; full-sequence short predictions no worse
protocol.limitations: Repeated existing validation; no fresh test, no automatic promotion. Focused sampling changes training distribution; compare uniform fine-tuning control.
